channel.title: Rochdale Daily
channel.description: Independent local news, public-service information and reporting from Rochdale borough.

item.title: Morning Briefing: Monday 26 October 2026
item.description: 9 new stories in the Rochdale borough since yesterday evening.

item.title: Rochdale shortlisted for two national music festival awards
item.description: Rochdale's Feel Good Festival and Rochdale Music Stories have received nominations at the UK Festival Awards 2026, with voting open until November 3.

item.title: Free benefits checks at Littleborough and Wardle libraries on Monday and Tuesday
item.description: Council advisers will offer free, no booking needed benefits checks at Littleborough Library on 26 October and Wardle Library on 27 October, from 10am to noon.

item.title: Rochdale Council Tax Direct Debits delayed by one day after system error
item.description: Council Tax Direct Debits due on Monday 26 October will instead be collected on Tuesday 27 October, Rochdale Council says. The notice applies to the affected collection date.

item.title: Wednesday deadline to comment on parking changes in Rochdale, Littleborough and Milnrow
item.description: Residents have until Wednesday 28 October to comment on three proposed parking orders affecting Mere Street, Wardle Street and the Butterworth Hall area.

item.title: New book showcases unseen 1930s photographs of Rochdale's Norden Riviera
item.description: A new book featuring 600 unseen photographs captures the essence of 1930s Rochdale, including the lost Norden Riviera lido, highlighting the area's historical significance during a transformative decade.

item.title: New documentary explores the history of Hollingworth Lake
item.description: A new YouTube documentary delves into the fascinating history of Hollingworth Lake, revealing its origins and significance to the local community.

item.title: Road closures for Wardle Remembrance Sunday on 8 November 2026
item.description: Rochdale Borough Council has announced road closures in Wardle for Remembrance Sunday on 8 November 2026, affecting local traffic and access.

item.title: Tree falls across the top of Belfield Road
item.description: A large tree has come down at the top of Belfield Road in Rochdale, with its trunk and branches lying across the carriageway and pavement.

item.title: Rochdale awards event recognises achievements of over 200 cared for children
item.description: More than 200 children in care were celebrated at an awards event hosted by Rochdale Borough Council, recognising their achievements and resilience.

item.title: Rochdale vs Lionesses match postponed due to unforeseen circumstances
item.description: The match between Rochdale and the Lionesses, originally set to take place recently, has been postponed. This announcement was made by Salford City FC on their official website.

item.title: Traffic congestion on M62 near Rochdale following accident
item.description: An accident on the M62 has caused significant traffic delays on the eastbound carriageway between junctions 21 and 22, affecting commuters and local drivers.

item.title: Investigation launched after racist abuse incident at Rochdale nightclub
item.description: A woman has been filmed hurling racist abuse at a nightclub bouncer in Rochdale, prompting an investigation by Greater Manchester Police.

item.title: Remembrance Sunday services planned across Rochdale borough
item.description: Residents will gather on November 8 to honour those who served in the armed forces, with parades and services in multiple towns.

item.title: Morning Briefing: Sunday 25 October 2026
item.description: 10 new stories in the Rochdale borough since yesterday evening.

item.title: Rochdale mum diagnosed with breast cancer after routine NHS screening
item.description: Sarah Hickman, 50, encourages women to attend NHS breast screenings after her cancer was detected early during a routine mammogram.

item.title: Road closures in Milnrow for Remembrance Sunday on 8 November 2026
item.description: Milnrow will see temporary road closures on 8 November 2026 for Remembrance Sunday, as announced by Rochdale Borough Council.

item.title: Road closures in Norden for Remembrance Sunday on 8 November 2026
item.description: Norden will see temporary road closures on 8 November 2026 for Remembrance Sunday, affecting Woodhouse Lane and surrounding areas.

item.title: Road closures for Middleton Remembrance Sunday on 8 November 2026
item.description: Temporary road closures will be in effect in Middleton for Remembrance Sunday on 8 November 2026, affecting local traffic and access.

item.title: Road closures for Heywood Remembrance Sunday on 8 November 2026
item.description: Heywood will host its Remembrance Sunday event on 8 November 2026, leading to road closures in the area. The event will restrict vehicle access, ensuring a safe environment for attendees commemorating the occasion. According to a notice from Rochdale Borough Council, no alternative routes will be provided for vehicles during the event. This means that…

item.title: Rochdale AFC welcomes local groups for No Room for Racism fixture
item.description: Young people and their families from BACP and Army of Kindness were invited to join Rochdale AFC as flag bearers for the club’s annual No Room for Racism fixture.

item.title: Volunteers brave rain to help Rochdale Sea Cadets at Hollingworth Lake
item.description: Rochdale Sea Cadets have thanked Get Together After Serving CIC after volunteers spent a wet morning clearing overgrowth around their boat shed at Hollingworth Lake.

item.title: Halifax Road roadworks in Hurstead set to begin on 26 October 2026
item.description: Rochdale Borough Council has announced that roadworks on Halifax Road in Hurstead will begin at midnight on 26 October 2026 and are expected to continue until 1 November 2026. The works are part of ongoing improvements to the local infrastructure.

item.title: Bridge Street in Heywood closed over building safety concerns
item.description: GMFRS says firefighters attended for around two hours and 40 minutes after concerns about a building structure. The road's reopening remains unconfirmed.

item.title: Rochdale Council encourages reporting of concerns regarding HMOs
item.description: Residents are urged to report any issues with Houses in Multiple Occupation (HMOs) to ensure tenant safety and compliance with regulations.

item.title: Accrington Stanley thrash Rochdale 5-0 in League Two clash
item.description: Accrington Stanley secured a 5-0 win against Rochdale, marking their biggest away victory in Football League history, as they aim for a play-off spot in League Two.

item.title: The priest, the chicken and the shoe: Rochdale’s strangest Clegg Hall boggart story
item.description: A nineteenth‑century telling makes a monk barter a cock’s body and a shoe’s sole to silence the Clegg Hall boggart — but the murders and miracle belong to folklore, not parish records.

item.title: Weather warning issued for Rochdale as Storm Boelo approaches
item.description: Residents in Rochdale are advised to prepare for potential disruption as Storm Boelo is expected to bring strong winds and heavy rain this weekend.

item.title: Rochdale station regeneration scheme progresses with new homes and public square
item.description: A significant regeneration project around Rochdale railway station is underway, featuring new homes and a public square, aimed at improving access to the town centre.

item.title: Community efforts revive historic Lodge Mill after devastating fire
item.description: Lodge Mill in Middleton, a historic site dating back to 1850, is seeing a revival thanks to community support following a fire that left it in ruins.

item.title: Morning Briefing: Saturday 24 October 2026
item.description: 4 new stories in the Rochdale borough since yesterday evening.

item.title: Upcoming services and events at st Luke’s Church, Deeplish
item.description: St Luke’s Church in Deeplish is hosting several community events this week, including a Holy Communion service and a women’s breakfast.

item.title: Decision on 450-home development in Bamford delayed again
item.description: The planning committee has deferred a decision on a housing scheme in Bamford, citing insufficient drainage details and historical flooding issues.

item.title: Rochdale wins gold at Britain in Bloom awards, crowned champion
item.description: Rochdale has been awarded gold at this year’s Britain in Bloom awards, securing the title of overall winner in the Town Centres and City Centres category.

item.title: Rochdale Borough Council awards £1.1 million contract for young people's accommodation
item.description: Rochdale Borough Council has awarded a contract worth over £1 million to Stepping Stone Projects for a new supported accommodation service for young people at risk of homelessness.

item.title: £150 off energy bills: Rochdale households urged to watch for important letter
item.description: Warm Home Discount confirmation letters are arriving for eligible households, with the £150 energy credit applied over the winter rather than paid to everyone at once.

item.title: Rochdale projects £10.6 million spending on roads as repair programme targets borough streets
item.description: Council figures project £10.63 million in carriageway maintenance spending for 2026/27, around 26 per cent more than the previous year.

item.title: Roadworks on Elizabethan Way in Milnrow to begin on 23 October 2026
item.description: Rochdale Borough Council has announced that roadworks will commence on Elizabethan Way in Milnrow from 9pm on Friday, 23 October 2026, until 6am on Saturday, 24 October 2026, or until the work is completed, whichever is sooner.

item.title: Rochdale Council seeks feedback on Bowlee Car Boot Sale for 2027 improvements
item.description: Rochdale Borough Council is inviting providers to participate in a survey aimed at improving the fee setting process for adult social care services.

item.title: Your Trust hosts family activities during October half term in Rochdale
item.description: Your Trust is offering a variety of family-friendly activities across multiple venues in Rochdale this October half term, including a special Halloween pool party.

item.title: From six modems to 580 staff: Rochdale’s Zen Internet puts people and planet alongside profit
item.description: Rochdale’s Zen Internet grew from £5,000 and six dial-up modems into a national broadband provider. Its B Corp approach puts customers, staff and the environment alongside profit.

item.title: The Healey Dell prophecy: Eleanor Byron, Mother Bagden and what the records actually show
item.description: A short guide to the strange local tale that a Lady Eleanor was “maid, wife and widow in one day” — what early collectors wrote, what the Heritage Centre tells visitors, and what survives as documentary fact.

item.title: Roadworks planned for Toad Lane and surrounding streets on 6 November 2026
item.description: Rochdale Borough Council has announced roadworks that will temporarily close several streets in the area on 6 November 2026, affecting local traffic and access.

item.title: Roadworks scheduled on Kirkstall Avenue in Littleborough on 6 November 2026
item.description: Kirkstall Avenue in Littleborough will be temporarily closed for roadworks starting on 6 November 2026, affecting local traffic and access.

item.title: Rochdale selected for £9.4m children’s mental health pilot
item.description: Breaking: Rochdale will join Stockport and Tameside in Care Together, bringing NHS mental health professionals into children’s social care teams from early 2027.

item.title: Planning approved for new £11.4 million special needs school in Rochdale
item.description: Rochdale Council has received planning permission to build a new special needs school, set to open in 2028, aimed at supporting children with complex needs.

item.title: Morning Briefing: Friday 23 October 2026
item.description: 1 new story in the Rochdale borough since yesterday evening.

item.title: Plans for 17-storey tower next to historic Marble Arch pub rejected
item.description: Councillors have rejected a proposal for a 17-storey tower block beside the Grade II-listed Marble Arch pub in Manchester, citing concerns over its impact on the historic site.

item.title: Rochdale Council generates nearly £3 million from parking fines over three years
item.description: Rochdale Council has collected £2.88 million from parking fines since 2023, with funds reinvested into local road infrastructure.

item.title: Rochdale woman loses over 12 stone and reaches Slimming World semi-finals
item.description: Vikki Gurney from Rochdale has lost 12 stone 3 pounds and reached the semi-finals of Slimming World’s Woman of the Year competition, meeting Olympic champion Nicola Adams in the process.
